newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch credit insurer NCM 1996 profit NLG 14.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Dutch credit insurer NCM 1996 profit NLG 14.2 mln.

text.p: Dutch credit insurer NCM said on Thursday it posted net profits of 14.2 million guilders in 1996 versus a loss of 4.8 million guilders in 1995.
In March the credit insurer warned its profits for 1996 as a whole would not have increased much beyond the the 13.8 million earned in the year's first half.

NCM Holding is the holding company for a number of operating companies which together form the NCM Group: Nederlandsche Credietverzekering Maatschappij NV (NCM-NL), NCM Credit Insurance Ltd (NCM-UK) and NCM International (NCM-INT).
NCM International has branches in the United States, Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Belgium and Israel.
